events.title: A wolf at the fire
events.text: A lone wolf circles the camp at dusk, drawn by the smell of the store. The hunters are away.

options.text: Drive it off with a burning branch.
options.note: {hero} drove a wolf from the fire with a burning branch, and {other} saw it.

options.text: Wake the elders and stay behind them.
options.note: {hero} woke {other} when a wolf came to the fire.

options.text: Throw it a share of the store.
options.note: {hero} bought off a hungry wolf with the clan's food, and {other} did not approve.

events.title: The lost flint
events.text: You find a fine piece of flint in the riverbed that belongs to no one, or to whoever comes for it.

options.text: Keep it and learn to work it.
options.note: {hero} found a good piece of flint and kept it.

options.text: Trade it for a favour.
options.note: {hero} traded a piece of flint to {other} for a favour.

options.text: Give it to the clan's knapper.
options.note: {hero} gave a fine piece of flint away, and {other} was glad.

events.title: A sick child
events.text: A small child burns with fever. The healer is far away, and someone must sit through the night.

options.text: Sit with the child all night.
options.note: {hero} sat through the night with a sick child, and {other} never forgot it.

options.text: Search the hills for herbs.
options.note: {hero} went into the hills for herbs for a sick child, for {other}.

events.title: The old song
events.text: An old woman by the fire begins a song about how the world began and invites you to learn it.

options.text: Learn every word.
options.note: {hero} learned the old song from {other}.

options.text: Listen, but slip away early.
options.note: {hero} left {other}'s song before its end.

options.text: Ask what the song is worth.
options.note: {hero} asked {other} what the old song was worth, and was not thanked.

events.title: The river crossing
events.text: The river is high. Across it, a herd grazes; behind you, the clan is hungry.

options.text: Swim across and stalk the herd.
options.note: {hero} swam the high river to hunt, and {other} watched from the bank.

options.text: Wait for the water to fall.
options.note: {hero} waited out the river with {other}.

events.title: A stranger's child
events.text: A child from another clan wanders into your camp, lost and hungry.

options.text: Feed the child and bring it home.
options.note: {hero} fed a lost child of another clan and led it home.

options.text: Trade it for food and leave.
options.note: {hero} sent a lost child away for a meal, and {other} heard of it.

options.text: Take it to the elders.
options.note: {hero} brought a lost child to {other}.

events.title: The fire goes out
events.text: You were to watch the fire. You slept, and in the grey morning the coals are cold.

options.text: Confess and rebuild it yourself.
options.note: {hero} let the fire go out, confessed to {other}, and lit it again.

options.text: Borrow fire from another camp before anyone wakes.
options.note: {hero} borrowed a flame in secret after the fire died.

options.text: Say it was the wind.
options.note: {hero} lied to {other} about the cold fire.

events.title: Market day
events.text: Traders from the other clan camp at the ford with furs and worked stone. They will deal with anyone who is bold enough.

options.text: Haggle for a good price on the clan's behalf.
options.note: {hero} haggled with the traders and came home with a good price, and {other} was pleased.

options.text: Watch and learn how they trade.
options.note: {hero} watched the traders with {other}.

events.title: A hard winter
events.text: Snow has lain for weeks. The store is low and people are quiet.

options.text: Give up your own share for someone weaker.
options.note: {hero} gave up a share of food in a hard winter for {other}.

options.text: Go out and hunt in the snow.
options.note: {hero} hunted through the snow for the clan, with {other} waiting.

options.text: Keep your head down and save your strength.
options.note: {hero} kept to the furs through the hard winter.

events.title: The cave paintings
events.text: In a cave above the river you find old paintings of animals and hands, and a place where someone once kept a fire.

options.text: Add your own hand to the wall.
options.note: {hero} left a hand on the cave wall, with {other} beside.

options.text: Gather the flint from the cave floor.
options.note: {hero} took flint from the cave floor.

options.text: Leave, uneasy.
options.note: {hero} left the painted cave, uneasy.

events.title: The quarrel at the store
events.text: Two people shout over the last of the dried berries. Everyone looks at you.

options.text: Split the berries fairly.
options.note: {hero} split the berries between quarrelling people, and {other} was grateful.

options.text: Take their side against the stronger.
options.note: {hero} took {other}'s side in a quarrel at the store.

options.text: Walk away.
options.note: {hero} walked away from a quarrel at the store.

events.title: The first kill
events.text: The hunters give you the spear for the last throw at a wounded deer.

options.text: Throw true.
options.note: {hero} made a first kill with a spear throw, and {other} was proud.

options.text: Hand the spear back: the deer should be spared.
options.note: {hero} would not make the last throw, and {other} shrugged.
